lessons.title: Still-start upward and forward force
lessons.effort: Start a decisive upward leg push before a still-base forward release.
lessons.brief: Open with Squat Jump — settled quarter-squat start as the controlled lower-body force anchor. Start a decisive upward leg push before a still-base forward release.

connections.title: Settled force onset
connections.cue: Squat Jump — settled quarter-squat start and Medicine Ball Chest Pass — stationary, paused: Settle the body and load before accelerating; use the same clear start discipline for upward leg projection and forward hand release.

connections.title: Force through a stable finish
connections.cue: Calf Raise — rapid supported rise, no flight and Band Row — seated, fast pull: Keep the support base organized while force builds toward the ankle-rise or arm-draw finish; reset without rocking the torso.

connections.title: Hip initiation into hand force
connections.cue: Split-stance explosive hip pivot and Med Ball Rotational Scoop Toss — paused standing start; floor-target adaptation: Settled rotational projection beside an isolated grounded hip/foot initiation.

lessons.title: Grounded hip drive and fast traction
lessons.effort: Drive the hips sharply while expressing a quick arm pull and controlled hand push-off.
lessons.brief: Open with Two-Hand Landmine Bent-Over Row — fast pull from a pause as the controlled upper-body force anchor. Drive the hips sharply while expressing a quick arm pull and controlled hand push-off.

connections.title: Force from a parked load
connections.cue: Two-Hand Landmine Bent-Over Row — fast pull from a pause and Kettlebell Swing — dead-stop two-hand repetitions: Organize the held starting load before accelerating; preserve the row's still trunk and the swing's deliberate hip drive as separate ways of producing force.

connections.title: Impulse and controlled reception
connections.cue: Plyo Push-Up — hands elevated and Medicine Ball Scoop Toss — hip-driven forward release: Direct a decisive push through the support before the body or ball moves away, then control the body's finish; only the push-up includes a hand reception.

connections.title: Supported rotational force
connections.cue: Standing low roundhouse shadow kick and Half-Kneeling Rotational Med Ball Throw — floor-target adaptation: Reduce upper leg propulsion in the throw while directly expressing the lower hip-led kick.

lessons.title: Lead-leg projection and independent release
lessons.effort: Use a controlled lateral plant to initiate grounded hip rotation and a diagonal upper-body finish. Retain forward leg and independent arm projection as supporting force work.
lessons.brief: Open with Lateral step-in to rotational plant as the grounded rotational force anchor. Convert arriving lateral bodyweight into a grounded foot-and-hip turn with a controlled split-stance finish.

connections.title: Turn and control the finish
connections.cue: Lateral step-in to rotational plant and Med Ball Overhead to Side Slam — non-rebounding slam-ball execution: Downward arm finish plus lateral bodyweight accepted into a grounded hip turn.

connections.title: Preload into forward projection
connections.cue: Standing Broad Jump — dip, project and stick and Medicine Ball Chest Pass — shallow countermovement: Use the declared small preload to direct force forward, finishing balanced without an extra approach or torso turn.

connections.title: Lead-side support and finish
connections.cue: Step-Up — fast grounded drive, rear foot joins and Medicine Ball Shot Put Throw — forward-facing, no rotation: Maintain pressure through the declared support stance and finish balanced as the lead leg rises or the independent arm releases.

lessons.title: Hip-driven release and arm-only projection
lessons.effort: Project from the hips, then isolate the forward arm release from unnecessary leg assistance.
lessons.brief: Open with Medicine Ball Scoop Toss — paused hinge start as the controlled lower-body force anchor. Project from the hips, then isolate the forward arm release from unnecessary leg assistance.

connections.title: Hip force with a controlled trunk
connections.cue: Medicine Ball Scoop Toss — paused hinge start and Kneeling Medicine Ball Chest Pass — tall kneeling, no hip swing: Establish a steady trunk before projection; allow the scoop's hip drive while preserving the kneeling pass's arm-led release.

connections.title: Supported traction and hip extension
connections.cue: Glute Bridge — fast grounded rise, settled floor start and Seated Hand-over-Hand Battle-Rope Pull — free rope on floor: Use the available ground support to stabilize the body while the arms draw or the hips extend; avoid finishing by leaning or arching the back.

connections.title: Hip initiation into hand force
connections.cue: Lead-leg low roundhouse without a gather step and Light-band rotational cross: Forward rotational punch paired with lead-leg hip-led output.

lessons.title: Guided push and supported ascent
lessons.effort: Accelerate a guided arm push and a supported upward effort.
lessons.brief: Open with Landmine Press — one-arm strict speed press as the controlled upper-body force anchor. Accelerate a guided arm push and a supported upward effort.

connections.title: Drive from an organized base
connections.cue: Landmine Press — one-arm strict speed press and Kettlebell Swing — continuous two-hand chest-height float: Keep the support pressure organized as force begins; the strict press uses no leg dip, while the retained swing expresses its deliberate hip impulse.

connections.title: Supported upward force
connections.cue: Foot-Supported Pull-Up — fast ascent, controlled return and Seated Vertical Jump — low bench start to floor landing: Drive upward from the declared support without rocking for momentum, then control the return or two-foot reception.

connections.title: Supported rotational force
connections.cue: Pre-chambered bent-knee roundhouse whip and Two-hand band backhand speed sweep: Transverse hand sweep and short-lever thigh sweep express rotation without more release or terminal kick volume.

lessons.title: Ankle rebound and overhead draw
lessons.effort: Organize a forward plant into a grounded hip turn and compact rotational hand arc. Ankle rebound, a supported split-leg rise and linear arm pressing/pulling support that base and finish.
lessons.brief: Open with Forward plant-and-open to kick stance as the grounded rotational force anchor. Accept forward arrival onto a leg before freeing the other thigh for a kick.

connections.title: Turn and control the finish
connections.cue: Forward plant-and-open to kick stance and Rotational shadow hook: Compact unloaded upper turn paired with forward arrival into an open lower stance.

connections.title: Compact ankle and arm finish
connections.cue: Ankle Pogo in Place — short bilateral set and Band Chest Press — simultaneous fast extension, no release: Keep the action compact and the support organized, with a clear ankle or arm finish; retain the pogo's brief contacts without speeding the band's return.

connections.title: Stable-base upward force
connections.cue: Split Squat — fast supported rise, no flight and Band Straight-Arm Pulldown — rapid shoulder extension: Hold the support stance steady while the leg rises or shoulders draw the arms down, with no trunk crunch or unwanted turn.

lessons.title: Split-base projection and downward draw
lessons.effort: Project from a fixed split base while expressing clear downward and forward arm force.
lessons.brief: Open with Split-Stance Broad Jump — fixed lead, two-foot reception as the controlled lower-body force anchor. Project from a fixed split base while expressing clear downward and forward arm force.

connections.title: Directed force from a fixed base
connections.cue: Split-Stance Broad Jump — fixed lead, two-foot reception and Medicine Ball Overhead Slam — tall kneeling, arm-driven: Start from the declared support position and direct force into the forward jump or downward arm release; maintain a controlled finish in the chosen line.

connections.title: Distal force finish
connections.cue: Calf Raise — single-leg fast supported finish, no flight and Medicine Ball Chest Pass — stationary, paused: Keep the body organized while force passes through the ankle rise or forward hand release; do not add a leg bounce to the stationary pass.

connections.title: Hip initiation into hand force
connections.cue: Low roundhouse from a held split-squat start and Med Ball Countermovement Rotational Throw — floor target: Upper reversal projection and lower still-start rotational force are distinct tasks; no assumption that one proves mastery of the other.

lessons.title: Independent hip and overhead force
lessons.effort: Produce force through one hip and an independent overhead arm draw.
lessons.brief: Open with Band Lat Pulldown — single-arm rapid elbow drive as the controlled upper-body force anchor. Produce force through one hip and an independent overhead arm draw.

connections.title: Independent force with pelvic control
connections.cue: Band Lat Pulldown — single-arm rapid elbow drive and Glute Bridge — single-leg rapid rise with level pelvis: Keep the pelvis and rib cage organized while one arm draws or one hip extends, avoiding a lateral trunk bend to finish.

connections.title: Shoulder initiation and leg-driven release
connections.cue: Scapular Pull-Up — foot-supported quick initiation and Medicine Ball Scoop Toss — fixed split stance, forward release: Stabilize the trunk so the intended shoulder initiation or leg-to-ball impulse stays clear; preserve the scoop's forward release line.

connections.title: Supported rotational force
connections.cue: Seated light-band hip-rotation acceleration and Rotational band row speed drive: Load the pulling-side turn quickly while directly accelerating hip internal rotation in a supported seated task.

lessons.title: Lead-leg ascent and traction onset
lessons.effort: Drive laterally from a held split stance into an open rotational base and an outward upper-body release. Lead-leg ascent, a short linear start and arm draws reinforce support and the pulling finish.
lessons.brief: Open with Lateral release step from held split stance as the grounded rotational force anchor. Release planted leg force into a grounded turn when there is no incoming momentum.

connections.title: Turn and control the finish
connections.cue: Lateral release step from held split stance and Two-hand medicine-ball backhand throw: Outward upper sweep paired with a held-start lateral leg push that opens into a rotational stance.

connections.title: Supported onset and controlled reversal
connections.cue: Step-Up to Knee Drive — fast ascent, no flight and Band Row — controlled reach into immediate fast reversal: Use stable support to organize the lead-leg drive or loaded arm reversal, then finish without borrowing a torso rock.

connections.title: Short force impulse and reset
connections.cue: Standing Split-Start Acceleration — 2 m, full stop and Band Biceps Curl — rapid neutral-grip pull: Produce the short forward start or elbow-flexion impulse from an organized base, then regain control before the next attempt.

lessons.title: Held hand push and vertical leg drive
lessons.effort: Express a settled arm push and a direct upward leg impulse.
lessons.brief: Open with Countermovement Jump — vertical rise and stick as the controlled lower-body force anchor. Express a settled arm push and a direct upward leg impulse.

connections.title: Controlled start into projection
connections.cue: Countermovement Jump — vertical rise and stick and Plyo Push-Up — paused bottom start, hands elevated: Organize the start before the rapid impulse and accept the hand or foot reception under control; keep each task's prescribed preload distinct.

connections.title: Force against a retained load
connections.cue: Seated Bent-Knee Calf Raise — fast light rise and Two-Hand Landmine Bent-Over Row — fast pull from a pause: Stabilize the support base while the ankle or arms accelerate the retained load, then lower under control without an extra body lift.

connections.title: Hip initiation into hand force
connections.cue: Low roundhouse to suspended re-chamber and Step-in rotational medicine-ball shot-put: Step-in upper push and controlled lower kick recoil organize an active finish.

lessons.title: Short reception to controlled release
lessons.effort: Receive a small load or landing, settle it, and produce the next clear force action.
lessons.brief: Open with Band Triceps Pressdown — rapid elbow extension as the controlled upper-body force anchor. Receive a small load or landing, settle it, and produce the next clear force action.

connections.title: Finish force and regain support
connections.cue: Band Triceps Pressdown — rapid elbow extension and Box Jump — low target, stand and step down: Complete the elbow extension or upward leg drive decisively, then regain a quiet supported position; the box return remains a step down.

connections.title: Set the load before the next impulse
connections.cue: Medicine Ball Catch-Set Chest Pass — gentle coach feed and Kettlebell Swing — dead-stop two-hand repetitions: Control the received ball or parked kettlebell before producing the next clear force action; use the assigned reset rather than an uncontrolled continuous cycle.

connections.title: Supported rotational force
connections.cue: Low inward crescent shadow sweep and Light-band rotational uppercut: Rising hand arc and inward low-leg arc use complementary rotational paths.

lessons.title: Knee-to-ankle drive through the press finish
lessons.effort: Initiate controlled hip internal rotation and produce a lead-hand rotational pushing release. Grounded knee-to-ankle drive and linear arm presses supply supporting initiation and finishing force.
lessons.brief: Open with Seated light-band hip-rotation acceleration as the grounded rotational force anchor. Give the hip internal rotators a small rapid force-expression task without the balance or whole-kick demand.

connections.title: Turn and control the finish
connections.cue: Seated light-band hip-rotation acceleration and Lead-hand rotational medicine-ball push throw: Lead-hand rotational projection plus repeat seated hip torque avoids inventing a third rotating lower task; Class 4 pure chamber/recoil drills are not themselves rotation.

connections.title: Extension through a controlled boundary
connections.cue: Squat-to-Calf Rise — rapid extension, feet stay grounded and Floor Press — light dumbbells, fast concentric from floor contact: Carry force through the intended knee/ankle or arm extension, retaining the floor boundary and avoiding a back arch to finish.

connections.title: Independent contribution with a steady trunk
connections.cue: Reverse Lunge — quick front-leg return, no flight and Band Chest Press — one arm presses while opposite arm holds: Keep the support pressure and trunk organized while the front leg returns or one arm presses, preserving control of the opposite support or arm.

lessons.title: Receive, redirect and stick
lessons.effort: Convert a small received load or contact into the next force action, then regain control.
lessons.brief: Open with Broad Jump — two linked projections, final stick as the controlled lower-body force anchor. Convert a small received load or contact into the next force action, then regain control.

connections.title: Receive and redirect force
connections.cue: Broad Jump — two linked projections, final stick and Medicine Ball Receive-and-Return Chest Pass — single coach feed: Use the first controlled reception to organize the next projection, then regain control; keep the ball feed and the broad-jump contact small enough to redirect cleanly.

connections.title: Controlled return into the finish
connections.cue: Bent-Knee Calf Raise — single-leg rapid supported rise and Band Lat Pulldown — controlled upward reach into fast draw: Use a controlled lowering or loaded reach before the rapid ankle or arm finish, with the support base stable and no trunk swing.

connections.title: Hip initiation into hand force
connections.cue: Single-shuffle low roundhouse and Med Ball Shuffle-to-Rotation Throw — short floor-target version: Both endpoints express rotation after one small lateral arrival, with separate stations and full resets.

lessons.title: Preload through supported limbs
lessons.effort: Use a small preload to drive through a supported arm or leg without unnecessary travel.
lessons.brief: Open with Two-Hand Landmine Push Press — shallow dip, feet stay planted as the controlled upper-body force anchor. Use a small preload to drive through a supported arm or leg without unnecessary travel.

connections.title: Coordinate a permitted preload
connections.cue: Two-Hand Landmine Push Press — shallow dip, feet stay planted and Countermovement Jump — hands fixed at hips: Use the declared preload to sequence force into the jump or guided press, finishing without an extra dip or turn.

connections.title: Independent force with stable support
connections.cue: Medicine Ball Shot Put Throw — controlled arm draw into forward release and Single-Leg Hip Hinge — rapid return with hand support: Keep the supporting limb and trunk organized while the arm reverses to release or the hip returns from its hinge; use only the specified arm draw or hip motion.

connections.title: Supported rotational force
connections.cue: Crossover entry to rotational knee chamber and Drop-step rotational medicine-ball scoop throw: Rear upper loading step and lower crossover-to-chamber differentiate how weight arrives before rotation.

lessons.title: Retained hip return and linked hand push
lessons.effort: Accept a lateral arrival into a grounded hip turn and arrest a retained upper-body rotational arc. Linked hand pushes and leg-driven projection support a controlled impulse and finish.
lessons.brief: Open with Lateral step-in to rotational plant as the grounded rotational force anchor. Convert arriving lateral bodyweight into a grounded foot-and-hip turn with a controlled split-stance finish.

connections.title: Turn and control the finish
connections.cue: Lateral step-in to rotational plant and Close-held medicine-ball rotational snap-to-stop: Retained upper endpoint control paired with familiar lateral step-to-turn. Lower Class 5 jab-step has no explicit turn, so source Class 1 E5 is reused honestly.

connections.title: Brief return-to-force link
connections.cue: Kettlebell Swing — staggered-stance continuous pair and Plyo Push-Up — two linked pairs on elevated hands: Use the controlled return of the retained hip load or hand contact to organize the next impulse, then complete the planned reset.

connections.title: Directed implement projection
connections.cue: Medicine Ball Scoop Toss — upward-forward leg drive and Medicine Ball Overhead Forward Throw — fixed stance, arm-driven: Direct the ball along the declared forward path and keep the body's finish organized; preserve leg drive for the scoop and the arm-led overhead release.

lessons.title: Simple starts, smaller dose
lessons.effort: Rehearse organized force onset with a deliberately smaller midpoint workload.
lessons.brief: Open with Squat Jump — settled quarter-squat start as the controlled lower-body force anchor. Rehearse organized force onset with a deliberately smaller midpoint workload. Consolidate with the reduced planned exposure; previous prescriptions do not establish tolerance.

connections.title: Familiar settled starts
connections.cue: Squat Jump — settled quarter-squat start and Medicine Ball Chest Pass — still start on a spoken release cue: Use the familiar settled start before the upward jump or forward release, preserving control at the deliberately smaller midpoint dose.

connections.title: Stable-base force finish
connections.cue: Calf Raise — rapid supported rise, no flight and Two-Hand Landmine Bent-Over Row — fast pull from a pause: Keep the support base steady while the ankle or arms complete a short force action; avoid extra body movement to create speed.

connections.title: Hip initiation into hand force
connections.cue: Parallel-stance low roundhouse and Unloaded rotational diagonal hand drive: Unloaded diagonal upper action and reduced-dose parallel-start lower turn consolidate at two events each.

lessons.title: Grounded hip and gripping force
lessons.effort: Consolidate a grounded hip impulse and a short controlled arm-force transfer.
lessons.brief: Open with Supine Dumbbell Serratus Reach — brief rapid finish as the controlled upper-body force anchor. Consolidate a grounded hip impulse and a short controlled arm-force transfer. Consolidate with the reduced planned exposure; previous prescriptions do not establish tolerance.

connections.title: Supported force without flight
connections.cue: Supine Dumbbell Serratus Reach — brief rapid finish and Kettlebell Swing — dead-stop two-hand repetitions: Use the floor support to stabilize the body while the shoulder blades or hips produce the brief impulse, keeping the endpoint controlled.

connections.title: Controlled traction and hip finish
connections.cue: Seated Hand-over-Hand Battle-Rope Pull — free rope on floor and Glute Bridge — fast grounded rise, settled floor start: Keep the supported torso organized while the arms transfer traction or the hips rise; finish without a backward lean or back arch.

connections.title: Supported rotational force
connections.cue: Supported low outward crescent sweep and Close-held medicine-ball rotational snap-to-stop: Retained upper turn and supported outward low-leg sweep reduce release/landing exposure.

lessons.title: Low-dose lead-leg and release
lessons.effort: Consolidate direct hip external-rotation force and retained rotational pulling at the reduced planned dose. Small lead-leg and linear arm-force tasks support an organized base and finish.
lessons.brief: Open with Seated self-resisted hip external-rotation acceleration as the grounded rotational force anchor. Give the return-direction hip rotators a small rapid torque task with standing balance removed. Consolidate with the reduced planned exposure; previous prescriptions do not establish tolerance.

connections.title: Turn and control the finish
connections.cue: Seated self-resisted hip external-rotation acceleration and Rotational band row speed drive: Predictable upper pulling turn and seated direct hip external-rotation acceleration preserve rotational work with no flight or release.

connections.title: Low-dose support and finish
connections.cue: Step-Up — fast grounded drive, rear foot joins and Band Chest Press — simultaneous fast extension, no release: Maintain the declared support position while the lead leg rises or the arms press, completing each small force action without extra travel.

connections.title: Small projection with a balanced finish
connections.cue: Countermovement Jump — hands fixed at hips and Medicine Ball Shot Put Throw — forward-facing, no rotation: Express the compact vertical or forward impulse from the declared base and finish organized, keeping the independent arm release free of an added turn.

lessons.title: Independent takeoff and received return
lessons.effort: Express force through one takeoff leg and one returning arm while keeping reception controlled.
lessons.brief: Open with Single-Leg Vertical Takeoff — two-foot floor reception as the controlled lower-body force anchor. Express force through one takeoff leg and one returning arm while keeping reception controlled.

connections.title: Independent impulse and reception
connections.cue: Single-Leg Vertical Takeoff — two-foot floor reception and Medicine Ball Two-Hand Receive to Single-Arm Forward Return: Organize force through one takeoff leg or one returning arm, then control the two-foot landing or the body's release finish.

connections.title: Stable support for an independent finish
connections.cue: Bent-Knee Calf Raise — single-leg rapid supported rise and One-Arm Row — supported dumbbell speed pull: Keep the supported trunk and force-producing side organized while the calf or arm completes its draw, without adding a pelvic roll.

connections.title: Hip initiation into hand force
connections.cue: Lateral hip rock-to-pivot release and Externally supplied rotational scoop return: Controlled coach handoff adds supplied-ball organization; lower rock-to-pivot adds a small controlled reversal without a bounce.

lessons.title: Supported arm and staggered hip force
lessons.effort: Generate independent arm force and a staggered hip impulse from controlled support.
lessons.brief: Open with Floor Press — single-arm light dumbbell speed press as the controlled upper-body force anchor. Generate independent arm force and a staggered hip impulse from controlled support.

connections.title: Independent arm force and hip initiation
connections.cue: Floor Press — single-arm light dumbbell speed press and Kettlebell Swing — staggered dead-stop repetitions: Set the support and load before the impulse; retain trunk control through the independent press and the staggered hip-driven swing.

connections.title: One-side force with a level base
connections.cue: Band Lat Pulldown — single-arm rapid elbow drive and Glute Bridge — single-leg rapid rise with level pelvis: Keep the pelvis and rib cage organized as one arm draws or one hip rises, finishing without a lateral trunk bend.

connections.title: Supported rotational force
connections.cue: Bent-knee counter-sweep to chamber and Close-held medicine-ball rotational snap-to-stop: Familiar upper snap-to-stop and short bent-knee lower counter-sweep emphasize rapid turn with a controlled endpoint.

lessons.title: Single-leg control with guided projection
lessons.effort: Reorganize a grounded stance into rotational knee drive and a controlled upper-body hand sweep. Single-leg support and guided or free forward pressing reinforce force transfer.
lessons.brief: Open with Grounded switch-step rotational knee drive as the grounded rotational force anchor. Link a fast support-role exchange to proximal rotational output without a full additional kick.

connections.title: Turn and control the finish
connections.cue: Grounded switch-step rotational knee drive and Two-hand band backhand speed sweep: Predictable retained upper sweep and grounded lower stance exchange preserve rotation while avoiding linked-jump volume.

connections.title: Supported knee drive and guided projection
connections.cue: Single-Leg Squat Rise — supported rapid quarter-range and Landmine Push Press — single arm, shallow dip: Keep pressure through the supporting leg as force begins; retain the squat rise's support and the press's deliberate shallow dip-to-arm sequence.

connections.title: Small projection from organized support
connections.cue: Single-Leg Forward Takeoff — two-foot floor reception and Medicine Ball Chest Pass — stationary, paused: Direct the single-leg forward impulse or stationary hand release from a controlled base, then finish balanced without adding a run-up.

lessons.title: Hip-to-release and shoulder pull
lessons.effort: Transmit hip force into a release or draw, with a controlled ankle and shoulder finish.
lessons.brief: Open with Medicine Ball Scoop Toss — held hinge to forefoot finish as the controlled lower-body force anchor. Transmit hip force into a release or draw, with a controlled ankle and shoulder finish.

connections.title: Hip-to-implement force transfer
connections.cue: Medicine Ball Scoop Toss — held hinge to forefoot finish and Landmine Power Row — continuous hip-to-arm drive: Organize the hip impulse so it continues into the forward scoop or arm draw, finishing tall without an added lumbar arch.

connections.title: Controlled ankle and shoulder finish
connections.cue: Seated Bent-Knee Calf Raise — fast light rise and Medicine Ball Overhead Slam — single arm, no trunk rotation: Keep the support base organized while the ankle rises or shoulder drives the ball downward, preserving each task's declared line.

connections.title: Hip initiation into hand force
connections.cue: Forward step-in low roundhouse and Tall-kneeling diagonal medicine-ball side slam: Constrained-base upper diagonal slam and lower forward step-in kick separate trunk/hand expression from stance-leg arrival.

lessons.title: Full-foot rise and alternating traction
lessons.effort: Produce a grounded leg rise while transferring arm-force effort between sides.
lessons.brief: Open with Band Row — alternating arm draws from a fixed trunk as the controlled upper-body force anchor. Produce a grounded leg rise while transferring arm-force effort between sides.

connections.title: Grounded impulse with trunk control
connections.cue: Band Row — alternating arm draws from a fixed trunk and Kettlebell Swing — continuous two-hand chest-height float: Keep the torso organized while the alternating arms draw or the hips accelerate the retained implement; avoid adding a body rock to the row.

connections.title: Supported force into a clear finish
connections.cue: Kneeling Medicine Ball Chest Pass — tall kneeling, no hip swing and Sit-to-Stand — rapid full-foot push, no flight: Use the declared floor or kneeling support to organize the upward body rise or forward arm release, preserving the arm-only kneeling task.

connections.title: Supported rotational force
connections.cue: Forward plant to low rotational chamber and Single-arm rotational underhand medicine-ball scoop: Unilateral low-to-high hand projection and forward plant-to-rotational chamber express rotation without duplicating a full kick.

lessons.title: Ankle advance and forceful draw
lessons.effort: Practice separate hip-led low kicking and a descending upper-body rotational release, then regain controlled support. Small ankle advances, grounded leg return and linear arm draws support onset and finish.
lessons.brief: Open with Low roundhouse with forward step-down finish as the grounded rotational force anchor. Control residual forward/rotational momentum when the kicking leg becomes the next lead foot.

connections.title: Turn and control the finish
connections.cue: Low roundhouse with forward step-down finish and Two-hand descending backhand medicine-ball throw: Descending upper hand arc and lower kick with a controlled forward recovery finish require distinct endpoint control.

connections.title: Compact forward and elbow impulse
connections.cue: Ankle Pogo — three small forward advances and Band Biceps Curl — loaded return into quick reversal: Keep the action compact as the ankles advance the body or elbows reverse the loaded curl, retaining control before the next effort.

connections.title: Grounded return and shoulder draw
connections.cue: Reverse Lunge to Knee Drive — fast grounded return and Band Straight-Arm Pulldown — rapid shoulder extension: Control the support position through the leg return or shoulder-only pull, finishing without a trunk crunch or unnecessary travel.

lessons.title: Step-close vertical and forward release
lessons.effort: Time a controlled foot plant with upward leg projection or forward arm release.
lessons.brief: Open with Walk-In Vertical Jump — step-close takeoff as the controlled lower-body force anchor. Time a controlled foot plant with upward leg projection or forward arm release.

connections.title: Plant before projection
connections.cue: Walk-In Vertical Jump — step-close takeoff and Medicine Ball Step-In Chest Pass — one forward plant: Organize the controlled foot plant before the upward jump or forward release, retaining the declared step pattern and a balanced finish.

connections.title: Controlled reversal with a stable trunk
connections.cue: Glute Bridge — controlled lower to rapid reversal and Band Lat Pulldown — single-arm rapid elbow drive: Keep the torso supported and organized while the hip reverses upward or the independent arm draws, without adding rotation to either source task.

connections.title: Hip initiation into hand force
connections.cue: Retreat-step low roundhouse counter and Lateral-step two-hand medicine-ball backhand throw: Lateral upper entry and retreating lower entry demand controlled direction-specific plants before rotation.

lessons.title: Forward plant into controlled projection
lessons.effort: Project from a controlled forward entry and regain support before repeating.
lessons.brief: Open with Medicine Ball Step-In Shot Put — forward-facing single arm as the controlled upper-body force anchor. Project from a controlled forward entry and regain support before repeating.

connections.title: Forward entry into a directed impulse
connections.cue: Medicine Ball Step-In Shot Put — forward-facing single arm and Walk-In Broad Jump — step-close forward takeoff: Time the controlled forward entry to the leg projection or independent arm release, then regain support without running through.

connections.title: Push from stable support and finish controlled
connections.cue: Standing Wall Power Push-Off — return to upright and Step-Down to Step-Up — quick grounded reversal: Use a secure support contact to produce the next push, finishing upright or on the step; neither task adds a drop or a rebound hand catch.

connections.title: Supported rotational force
connections.cue: Pre-chambered hip-unwind step-down and Drop-step rotational medicine-ball shot-put: Upper drop-step pushing release and lower supported hip unwind express force out of a loaded orientation.

lessons.title: Backward traction and forward leg drive
lessons.effort: Generate compact folded-leg and hand sweeps through controlled hip and trunk turns. Grounded lunge return, leg-driven forward projection and linear arm traction supply plant and finish support.
lessons.brief: Open with Low bent-knee hook shadow sweep as the grounded rotational force anchor. Practice the coupled inward thigh sweep and knee folding used to recover a rotational leg action.

connections.title: Turn and control the finish
connections.cue: Low bent-knee hook shadow sweep and Short crossover-to-band backhand speed sweep: Upper crossover-to-retained sweep and low folding hook sweep retain transverse outputs without another airborne task.

connections.title: Plant to direct force
connections.cue: Forward Lunge — rapid return to the starting foot line and Battle-Rope Traction Pull — one backward step per draw: Use the declared forward or backward plant to organize the connected leg or arm effort, then stop and reset within the controlled movement corridor.

connections.title: Leg impulse into implement force
connections.cue: Medicine Ball Scoop Toss — walk-step forward release and Two-Hand Landmine Push Press — shallow dip, feet stay planted: Sequence the declared leg drive into the guided press or scoop release, keeping the finish balanced and free of an extra jump.

lessons.title: Mid-range force and complete leg finish
lessons.effort: Drive through a defined finish range while producing a clear upward leg impulse.
lessons.brief: Open with Countermovement Jump — vertical rise and stick as the controlled lower-body force anchor. Drive through a defined finish range while producing a clear upward leg impulse.

connections.title: Force from a defined start
connections.cue: Countermovement Jump — vertical rise and stick and Band Chest Press — mid-range pause into fast finish: Respect the declared start boundary before accelerating toward the jump or press finish; do not add a second dip after the arm's mid-range pause.

connections.title: Support pressure through the finish
connections.cue: Split-Stance Calf Rise — rapid rear-heel finish and Band Row — mid-range pause into fast finish: Keep pressure organized through the support stance while the rear heel rises or arms complete the held-start draw, without a torso swing.

connections.title: Hip initiation into hand force
connections.cue: Point-cued open-step hip turn and Single-arm rotational medicine-ball hook throw: Unilateral upper hook release and early point-cued lower turn pair a hand-force task with a modest decision demand; no midmovement cues.

lessons.title: Supported ascent and shoulder force
lessons.effort: Express a supported lower-body rise and a brief shoulder-driven upper action.
lessons.brief: Open with Dumbbell Reverse Fly — quick lift, controlled return as the controlled upper-body force anchor. Express a supported lower-body rise and a brief shoulder-driven upper action.

connections.title: Supported ascent and shoulder opening
connections.cue: Dumbbell Reverse Fly — quick lift, controlled return and Step-Up — fast grounded drive, rear foot joins: Stabilize the body through the support leg or held hinge so the intended knee drive or shoulder opening supplies the motion.

connections.title: Controlled hip and hand push
connections.cue: Standing Wall Power Push-Off — return to upright and Hip Thrust — bench-supported rapid rise: Use stable support to produce the hip rise or hand push-off, finishing tall without lumbar extension or an added rebound.

connections.title: Supported rotational force
connections.cue: Coach-called-leg low roundhouse and Med Ball Rotational Scoop Toss — paused floor-target start: Familiar settled upper scoop lowers novelty while a called lower leg changes preparation responsibility.

lessons.title: Split-base push and catch-set release
lessons.effort: Initiate a compact hip-turning thigh action from the early cue and express a separate unloaded upper-body backhand arc. Split-base leg force and catch-set forward release support an organized start and finish.
lessons.brief: Open with Auditory-go pre-chambered thigh whip as the grounded rotational force anchor. Release proximal rotation from a prepared leg position without anticipating the start.

connections.title: Turn and control the finish
connections.cue: Auditory-go pre-chambered thigh whip and Unloaded two-hand rotational backhand sweep: Unloaded upper backhand and early auditory-go folded-thigh sweep produce compact rotational arcs with no release or jump.

connections.title: Receive control before another impulse
connections.cue: Split Squat Jump — fixed stance, same-stance reception and Medicine Ball Catch-Set Chest Pass — gentle coach feed: Control the prescribed foot reception or gentle ball feed before repeating, preserving the split-base landing and the set-before-release requirement.

connections.title: Retained-load acceleration with a steady finish
connections.cue: Kettlebell Swing — continuous two-hand chest-height float and Band Biceps Curl — rapid neutral-grip pull: Keep the body organized as the hips or elbows accelerate their retained load, then control the return without an extra trunk swing.

lessons.title: Receive and project from controlled starts
lessons.effort: Link a controlled contact or plant to the next clear force action.
lessons.brief: Open with Vertical Jump — two linked rises, final stick as the controlled lower-body force anchor. Link a controlled contact or plant to the next clear force action.

connections.title: Contact and plant into projection
connections.cue: Vertical Jump — two linked rises, final stick and Medicine Ball Receive-Step Chest Pass — one controlled plant: Use the controlled foot contact or received-ball plant to organize the next projection, then regain balance before the next sequence.

connections.title: Clear onset from organized support
connections.cue: Kettlebell Deadlift — rapid full-foot rise, no swing and Band Row — two-arm pull from a spoken cue: Set the support and load before the cued draw or grounded leg rise, finishing without an added jump or torso turn.

connections.title: Hip initiation into hand force
connections.cue: Low roundhouse through an empty direction gate and Handoff-to-step rotational medicine-ball scoop return: Coach handoff followed by one short upper step and a low kick through an empty direction gate target controlled placement.

lessons.title: Cued arm force and grounded leg reversal
lessons.effort: Express force from a clear cue or controlled reversal while retaining grounded support.
lessons.brief: Open with Single-Arm Band Chest Press — still start on a spoken cue as the controlled upper-body force anchor. Express force from a clear cue or controlled reversal while retaining grounded support.

connections.title: Controlled reversal and clear cue
connections.cue: Single-Arm Band Chest Press — still start on a spoken cue and Step-Down to Step-Up — quick grounded reversal: Keep the support position stable as the step reverses or the cued arm presses, with the intended start clear before accelerating.

connections.title: Grounded force with a tall finish
connections.cue: Landmine Power Row — continuous hip-to-arm drive and Glute Bridge — fast grounded rise, settled floor start: Use the deliberate hip impulse to produce the arm draw or bridge rise, finishing through the hips without arching the back.

connections.title: Supported rotational force
connections.cue: Short drop-step lead-leg roundhouse and Light-band rotational cross: Retained upper cross keeps setup familiar while the lower lead-leg kick uses a short support-hip loading step.

lessons.title: Brief contact to forward projection
lessons.effort: Place crossover recovery into a controlled rotational base and couple a separate step-in hip turn to an upper-body pushing release. Small linear leg, ankle and arm-force tasks support placement and the finish.
lessons.brief: Open with Crossover recovery to a marked kick base as the grounded rotational force anchor. Recover an exact useful two-foot base after reorientation, instead of leaving the feet crossed or too narrow.

connections.title: Turn and control the finish
connections.cue: Crossover recovery to a marked kick base and Step-in rotational medicine-ball shot-put: A familiar upper step-in press pairs with grounded crossover recovery to a marked kick base; no added jump contacts.

connections.title: Directed forward release
connections.cue: Medicine Ball Scoop Toss — fixed split stance, forward release and Medicine Ball Overhead Forward Throw — fixed stance, arm-driven: Keep the release line and body finish organized; use the scoop's leg drive and the overhead throw's arm action as distinct force routes.

connections.title: Brief contact and controlled reception
connections.cue: Ankle Pogo — two pairs with a full reset and Plyo Push-Up — hands elevated: Use the prescribed small foot or hand contact to organize the next force action, then complete the full reset without extending the sequence.

lessons.title: Review still-start force
lessons.effort: Review the combined program's opening lower and upper still-start tasks under recorded matching conditions.
lessons.brief: Open with Squat Jump — settled quarter-squat start as the controlled lower-body force anchor. Review the combined program's opening lower and upper still-start tasks under recorded matching conditions. Review current quality under matched recorded conditions where available; do not infer improvement from absent baseline data.

connections.title: Matched settled-start review
connections.cue: Squat Jump — settled quarter-squat start and Medicine Ball Chest Pass — stationary, paused: Match the recorded combined opening-class start and setup for the upward jump and forward release where actual records exist; absent baseline data establishes current quality only.

connections.title: Small controlled finish
connections.cue: Calf Raise — rapid supported rise, no flight and Dumbbell Reverse Fly — quick lift, controlled return: Keep the support base organized through the ankle rise or shoulder opening, using the small retained task as a controlled finish beside the review anchors.

connections.title: Hip initiation into hand force
connections.cue: Split-stance explosive hip pivot and Med Ball Rotational Scoop Toss — paused floor-target start: Repeat the combined Class 1 reduced-dose settled scoop and hip-pivot conditions when actual earlier conditions exist; no automatic improvement claim.

lessons.title: Review fixed-base independent force
lessons.effort: Review independent arm force and a grounded hip-driven projection with controlled starts.
lessons.brief: Open with Single-Arm Band Chest Press — still start on a spoken cue as the controlled upper-body force anchor. Review independent arm force and a grounded hip-driven projection with controlled starts. Review current quality under matched recorded conditions where available; do not infer improvement from absent baseline data.

connections.title: Clear start with retained support
connections.cue: Single-Arm Band Chest Press — still start on a spoken cue and Kettlebell Swing — dead-stop two-hand repetitions: Set the support and load before the cued independent press or parked hip impulse, retaining the source task's declared trunk behavior.

connections.title: Independent draw and leg-driven release
connections.cue: One-Arm Row — supported mid-range pause into fast finish and Medicine Ball Scoop Toss — hip-driven forward release: Keep the support and torso organized while the arm completes its held-start draw or the hips supply the forward scoop, without adding an unrecorded turn.

connections.title: Supported rotational force
connections.cue: Standing low roundhouse shadow kick and Med Ball Shot-Put Throw — rotational floor-target version: A short rotational pushing release and familiar rear-leg low kick revisit direct endpoints at reduced source dose.

lessons.title: Review lead-leg and arm sequence
lessons.effort: Review a low hip-led rotational kick with lateral recovery and a retained upper-body rotational pull. Supported lead-leg work and alternating or independent forward arm actions provide small linear-force support; no improvement is inferred without matched actual records.
lessons.brief: Open with Low roundhouse with lateral recovery placement as the grounded rotational force anchor. Control the return leg when restoring a base slightly off the original line after rotational output. Review current quality under matched recorded conditions where available; do not infer improvement from absent baseline data.

connections.title: Turn and control the finish
connections.cue: Low roundhouse with lateral recovery placement and Rotational band row speed drive: Retained upper pulling turn plus only one kick/side with lateral placement finishes the course without increasing the source kick dose.

connections.title: Supported rise and alternating finish
connections.cue: Step-Up — fast grounded drive, rear foot joins and Floor Press — alternating light speed presses, opposite arm parked: Maintain a stable body base while the lead leg rises or the arms alternate their presses, keeping the opposite support or load controlled.

connections.title: Independent force from organized support
connections.cue: Single-Leg Squat Rise — supported rapid quarter-range and Medicine Ball Shot Put Throw — forward-facing, no rotation: Keep the supporting leg and trunk organized as the single-leg rise or forward-facing arm release finishes, without adding rotation to either source task.
